name: rosetta-casting-out-nines
code:
use default

co9(x: long) -> long is
    let n mut = x

    while n >= 10L do
        let sum mut = 0L
        let m mut = n

        while m > 0L do
            sum = sum + m % 10L
            m = m / 10L
        od

        n = sum
    od

    n
si

co9_fast(x: long, base: long) -> long is
    let residue = x % (base - 1L)

    if residue == 0L /\ x > 0L then base - 1L else residue fi
si

write_line("part 1: digit-sum checksum")

for x in [318682L, 101558217124L, 65536L, 999999999L] do
    write_line("  co9({x}) = {co9(x)}")
od

write_line("part 2: k where co9(k) = co9(k^2), for k in 1L::100L")

let kaprekar_like =
    (1L::100L) |> filter(k => co9(k) == co9(k * k)) |> collect_list()
let kaprekar_text = kaprekar_like |> map(k => "{k}") |> join(", ")

write_line("  {kaprekar_like.count} of 100 numbers: {kaprekar_text}")

write_line("part 3: fast mod-based checksum, base 10")

for x in [318682L, 101558217124L, 65536L, 999999999L] do
    let fast = co9_fast(x, 10L)
    let matches = fast == co9(x)

    write_line("  co9_fast({x}, 10) = {fast}, matches part 1: {matches}")
od

write_line(
    "part 3: generalised to base 16, k where k mod 15 = k^2 mod 15, "
    "for k in 1L::100L"
)

let base16_like =
    (1L::100L)
    |> filter(k => co9_fast(k, 16L) == co9_fast(k * k, 16L))
    |> collect_list()
let base16_text = base16_like |> map(k => "{k}") |> join(", ")

write_line("  {base16_like.count} of 100 numbers: {base16_text}")
